pages.title: Ritual stuck?
pages.text: If a ritual appears stuck - no items being consumed - you should see grey particles around the $(item)Golden Sacrificial Bowl$(). If this is the case the ritual requires you to either $(l:rituals/item_use)use a specific item$(/l) or $(l:rituals/sacrifice)sacrifice a specific mob$(/l).$()

pages.title: Ritual stuck?
pages.text: $(br2)Find the ritual in the $(thing)Rituals$() category and check for instructions.$(br)
